lesson.title: 正弦与余弦函数的图像

en.title: Graphs of the Sine and Cosine Functions

source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition, Section 4.4

concepts.title: 正弦、余弦基本图像
concepts.summary: 定义域都是 $\mathbb R$，值域都是 $[-1,1]$，周期都是 $2\pi$。

method.title: 奇偶与零点
method.body: $\sin(-x)=-\sin x$，$\cos(-x)=\cos x$；正弦零点 $k\pi$，余弦零点 $\pi/2+k\pi$。正弦在 $\pi/2+2k\pi$ 最大，在 $3\pi/2+2k\pi$ 最小；余弦在 $2k\pi$ 最大，在 $\pi+2k\pi$ 最小，$k\in\mathbb Z$。

en.title: Basic sine and cosine graphs
en.summary: Both have domain $\mathbb R$, range $[-1,1]$, and period $2\pi$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Sine key values are $0,1,0,-1,0$ and cosine values $1,0,-1,0,1$ at $0,\pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2,2\pi$.

method.title: Parity and zeros
method.body: $\sin(-x)=-\sin x$, $\cos(-x)=\cos x$. Sine zeros are $k\pi$; cosine zeros are $\pi/2+k\pi$. Sine is maximal at $\pi/2+2k\pi$ and minimal at $3\pi/2+2k\pi$; cosine is maximal at $2k\pi$ and minimal at $\pi+2k\pi$, $k\in\mathbb Z$.

concepts.title: 振幅、周期与平移
concepts.summary: $y=a f[b(x-c)]+d$，$f=\sin$ 或 $\cos$，$a\ne0,b>0$。振幅 $|a|$，周期 $2\pi/b$，水平平移 $c$，中线 $y=d$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 将 $[c,c+2\pi/b]$ 四等分，计算五个关键点，再画光滑周期曲线；值域 $[d-|a|,d+|a|]$。

pitfalls: 先提出 $b$；$bx-k$ 的平移是 $k/b$。负 $a$ 表示反射，振幅仍非负。
周期公式要求 $a\ne0,b\ne0$；若 $b<0$，周期为 $2\pi/|b|$。若 $a=0$ 或 $b=0$，正弦/余弦模型为常函数，没有最小正周期。

en.title: Amplitude, period, and shifts
en.summary: For $y=a f[b(x-c)]+d$, $f=\sin$ or $\cos$, $a\ne0,b>0$, amplitude is $|a|$, period is $2\pi/b$, phase shift is $c$, and midline is $y=d$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Divide $[c,c+2\pi/b]$ into four equal parts, calculate five key points, and draw a smooth periodic curve; range is $[d-|a|,d+|a|]$.

pitfalls: Factor out $b$ first: the shift in $bx-k$ is $k/b$. Negative $a$ reflects the curve; amplitude stays nonnegative.
The period formula requires $a\ne0,b\ne0$; for $b<0$ use $2\pi/|b|$. If $a=0$ or $b=0$, a sine/cosine model is constant and has no smallest positive period.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 正振幅正弦从向上穿过中线的位置开始；正振幅余弦从最高点开始。若要求最小平移绝对值，在所有相差整周期的起点中选择。

en.title: Fit an equation to a graph

method.title: Method
method.body: A positive sine cycle starts at an upward midline crossing; a positive cosine cycle starts at a maximum. If least absolute phase shift is requested, compare all equivalent starts separated by whole periods.

concepts.title: 季节模型与周期数据
concepts.summary: 从表格极值估计振幅和中线，从重复间隔确定周期；由峰值月份定位相移。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 每年模型周期为12个月或365天。采用正弦模型时，相移比最高值的位置提前四分之一周期。

pitfalls: 拟合曲线是近似模型，不必通过每个表格点。

en.title: Seasonal models and periodic data
en.summary: Estimate amplitude and midline from table extrema, period from repetition, and phase from the peak month.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use 12 months or 365 days for an annual period. In a positive sine model, the phase start is a quarter period before the maximum.

pitfalls: A fitted curve is approximate and need not pass through every data point.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 从平衡点起用正弦；从最低点释放用负余弦；从最高点释放用正余弦。

en.title: Simple harmonic motion and frequency
en.summary: $y=a\sin\omega t$ or $a\cos\omega t$ with $a\ne0,\omega>0$ has period $T=2\pi/\omega$ and frequency $f=1/T$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use sine for an equilibrium start, negative cosine for release from a minimum, and positive cosine for release from a maximum.

concepts.title: 教材中的生物节律模型
concepts.summary: $P=\sin(2\pi t/23),E=\sin(2\pi t/28),I=\sin(2\pi t/33)$；$t$ 是出生后的实际天数。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用真实日期之差计算天数，再以弧度计算三个正弦值。教材把生物节律理论称为伪科学；这里仅研究它的正弦函数模型。

en.title: Textbook biorhythm models
en.summary: $P=\sin(2\pi t/23),E=\sin(2\pi t/28),I=\sin(2\pi t/33)$, where $t$ is the actual number of days since birth.

method.title: Method
method.body: Compute the actual date difference, then evaluate the three sines in radians. The textbook calls biorhythm theory pseudoscience; this is an exercise in its sinusoidal model.

concepts.title: 绝对值与包络线
concepts.summary: $|\sin x|$ 把负半波折到上方；$g(x)\sin x$ 在包络 $\pm|g(x)|$ 之间。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先画包络和零点，再判断每段正负与幅度；平方正弦可用降幂恒等式讨论周期。

en.title: Absolute values and envelopes
en.summary: $|\sin x|$ reflects negative arcs upward; $g(x)\sin x$ lies between envelopes $\pm|g(x)|$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Draw envelopes and zeros, then determine signs and varying amplitude; use a power-reduction identity for squared-sine periods.

questions.prompt: 在一个周期区间上作图：$y=3\cos(\tfrac12x)$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: 标准式为 $y=3\cos\left[\frac{1}{2}\left(x-(0)\right)\right]$，因此 $a=3,b=\frac{1}{2},c=0,d=0$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: $A=|a|=3$，$T=2\pi/b=4 \pi$，水平平移 $0$（正数向右，负数向左）。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: 从 $x=0$ 起每隔 $T/4=\pi$ 取点，五个关键点为 $(0,3),\quad (\pi,0),\quad (2 \pi,-3),\quad (3 \pi,0),\quad (4 \pi,3)$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: 按这些点连接平滑曲线，以周期向两边延伸；所有横坐标均为弧度。本图的一周区间为 $[0,4 \pi]$。

questions.answer: 标准式 $y=3\cos\left[\frac{1}{2}\left(x-(0)\right)\right]$；振幅 $3$；周期 $4 \pi$；相移 $0$；中线 $y=0$；值域 $[-3,3]$。

en.prompt: Graph the function over a one-period interval: $y=3\cos(\tfrac12x)$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: The standard form is $y=3\cos\left[\frac{1}{2}\left(x-(0)\right)\right]$, so $a=3,b=\frac{1}{2},c=0,d=0$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: $A=|a|=3$, $T=2\pi/b=4 \pi$, with phase shift $0$ (right if positive, left if negative).

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: Start at $x=0$ and step by $T/4=\pi$. The five key points are $(0,3),\quad (\pi,0),\quad (2 \pi,-3),\quad (3 \pi,0),\quad (4 \pi,3)$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: Join the points smoothly and repeat periodically in both directions; all x-values are in radians. This cycle is on $[0,4 \pi]$.

en.answer: Standard form $y=3\cos\left[\frac{1}{2}\left(x-(0)\right)\right]$; amplitude $3$; period $4 \pi$; phase shift $0$; midline $y=0$; range $[-3,3]$.
en.label: Example 1
